### Why Is the Widow of Zarephath Important in the Bible?
Author: Jason Soroski
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/why-is-the-widow-of-zarephath-important-in-the-bible.html
Passage: 1 Kings 17:8-16
Points:
- Elijah demonstrated radical faith by obeying God's counterintuitive instructions to seek refuge in Zarephath during a drought.
- The widow was destitute and preparing for death, yet God chose her to play a vital role in His work.
- Elijah tested the widow's faith by asking her to give first from her meager supplies before feeding herself and her son.
- In response to her trusting obedience, God miraculously kept her flour and oil from running dry day after day.
- Her sacrificial hospitality and belief provide an enduring model of faith that Jesus later commended in the Gospels.
